title: done's docs check is skipped when docs_map is empty (second-project run)
goal: done in a project whose docs_map is empty runs no docs check and prints no warning about kb/_self/map.csv

run:
import sys, tempfile, os, io, contextlib, subprocess, argparse, json
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bl_base, bl_land
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
def g(*a):
    return subprocess.run(['git', '-C', d, *a], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
g('init', '-q')
g('config', 'user.email', 'a@b.c')
g('config', 'user.name', 'n')
open(os.path.join(d, 'backlog.json'), 'w').write(json.dumps(dict(docs_map='')))
os.makedirs(os.path.join(d, 'src'))
open(os.path.join(d, 'src', 'a.py'), 'w').write('x = 1\n')
g('add', '-A')
g('commit', '-q', '-m', 'base')
open(os.path.join(d, 'src', 'a.py'), 'w').write('x = 2\n')
g('add', '-A')
g('commit', '-q', '-m', 'work\n\nKB-Work: BG-bbbbbbbb')
bl_base.load_settings(d)
bl = bl_base.Backlog(d)
bl.items['BG-bbbbbbbb'] = dict(id='BG-bbbbbbbb', kind='bug', title='t', status='todo', goal='g', touches=['src/**'], checks=[dict(run=['true'])])
out = io.StringIO()
msg = ''
try:
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out):
        bl_land.cmd_done(bl, argparse.Namespace(id='BG-bbbbbbbb', dry_run=True, commit=False, trailer=[]))
except Exception as e:
    msg = str(e)
text = msg + out.getvalue()
sys.exit(0 if 'is not done' in text and 'map.csv' not in text else 1)

notes: Run finding 9: warning: the docs check could not run: cannot read kb/_self/map.csv: No such file or directory (docs_map = "").
